newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: TENNIS-INJURED SELES WANTS TO DEFEND AUSTRALIAN CROWN.
newsitem.headline: TENNIS-INJURED SELES WANTS TO DEFEND AUSTRALIAN CROWN.

text.p: Monica Seles plans to defend her Australian Open title in January despite her troublesome shoulder injury.
The latest chapter in a season of disappointment and pain was written on Wednesday when Seles was forced out of the Komercni Banka Open exhibition event when her shoulder gave out once again.

"I have played my last exhibition and now I will relax and rest up to be ready for the Australian Open which I can't miss," she was quoted as saying in Thursday's Mlada Fronta Dnes newspaper. "Four times I won it and it is my favourite tournament.
"There are days when my shoulder hurts, and days when it doesn't. Right now it looks like an operation isn't necessary, but the situation can also change," she said.
